title: Taskbase Skills Coach — Framer relaunch
notes: The rebrand to "Taskbase Skills Coach", back on the apex domain, one release before the current site. The archive took this one well: the SSR markup is complete and all 53 webfaces plus every image but one are local, so the page is the real thing at 1440px. Treated like sibling 2026-live: the Framer .mjs module bundle is not loaded (it cannot resolve its dynamic imports offline and the SSR markup renders better without it), the events.framer.com tracker and the nine modulepreload / gstatic preconnect hints are gone, and responsive variants above 2048px were dropped — 39MB down to 17MB with no visual change at 1440px. Fully offline; nothing reaches a live host. What a static Framer mirror inherently loses: scroll-triggered motion and parallax, the case-study carousel frozen on the slide the SSR emitted, and the FAQ accordions rendered in their open state. One image was never crawled — the fourth case-study card in "10 Years of Learning Excellence" (PxWFrgTZ…png, no CDX capture at any timestamp); it is a white card at the right edge, repointed at a local not-archived/ path so it 404s instantly. Nav links (about-us, sales-coach, book-a-demo, contact-sales, imprint, privacy-policy) are relative and uncaptured, so they 404 rather than silently sending you to the 2026 site. Capture note: a --full screenshot of this page leaves the hero, two mid-page mockups and the dark CTA band blank however long it settles; the preview is one render at a 1440x10100 viewport instead.
